# Harrison Cutfield, Ray White North Shore Auckland

> Harrison Cutfield is a Ray White real estate agent on Auckland's North Shore, specialising in marketing and selling premium and luxury homes. He offers free, no-obligation property appraisals, off-market sales and tailored marketing campaigns.

## Key facts
- Name: Harrison Cutfield
- Role: Licensee Salesperson, Ray White Mairangi Bay and Milford (Ray White CR Group)
- Phone: 021 136 1955 (+64 21 136 1955)
- Email: harrison.cutfield@raywhite.com
- Office: 425 Beach Road, Mairangi Bay, Auckland 0630, New Zealand
- Website: https://harrisoncutfield.co.nz/
- Areas served: the entire North Shore of Auckland, including Devonport, Takapuna, Milford, Forrest Hill, Sunnynook, the East Coast Bays (Castor Bay, Campbells Bay, Mairangi Bay, Murrays Bay, Rothesay Bay, Browns Bay, Torbay, Long Bay), and the western and northern suburbs (Northcote, Birkenhead, Glenfield, Albany, Greenhithe)

## Services
- Free, no-obligation property appraisals for sellers
- Marketing and sale of premium and luxury residential homes
- Off-market (private) sales not advertised on public marketplaces
- Sales by auction, deadline sale or by negotiation
- Tailored vendor marketing campaigns with professional photography and video
